title: Abba HaDoresh
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: A Tanna, mentioned in Sifrei, Haazinu, on “Shichet,” in the wording “They said in the name of Abba HaDoresh.” Seder HaDorot says that Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta spoke in his name, citing Sifrei there on “Is He not your father,” which Hyman quotes as “Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta said in his name.” That work supposed this referred to Abba HaDoresh, but Hyman argues that examination of the passage provides no proof of that at all. He is also mentioned by this name in Sifrei, Berakhah, on “Bless, Lord, his strength,” and at the beginning of Shemot Rabbah, chapter 42: “This is Abba HaDoresh’s interpretation.”

notes.text: The consulted Sifrei Devarim 308 reads Abba HaDores, while Hyman supplies HaDoresh. At the consulted 309 passage on “Is He not your father,” Shimon ben Chalafta speaks without the quoted “in his name” formula. Hyman’s report of another reading and his rejection of the inference are preserved; other editions were not thereby disproved.
